title: I Will. Be Clean.
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: A man in one town had leprosy, a sickness that made skin sores. People with leprosy had to live away from everyone. Nobody would touch them. That is a lonely way to live.
The man saw Jesus and fell on his face. “Lord, if You want to, You can make me clean.”
Jesus could have healed him from far away. Instead, He reached out and touched him. “I will. Be clean.”
p2: Right away the sickness was gone! Jesus sent him to show the priest he was well. Soon big crowds came to Jesus.
Jesus touched the man nobody else would touch. He loves every person. Tomorrow, find someone sitting alone and ask, “Want to play with me?”
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
